workflows.title: FLUX.1 [dev] Text to Image
workflows.source: official template flux_dev_full_text_to_image from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: No negative prompt (cfg 1, distilled guidance). FluxGuidance node 1001 added so guidance is bindable (template implicit default is also 3.5). fp16 weights (23.8 GB) — ComfyUI offloads on 16-24 GB cards; set weight_dtype fp8 in node 194:46 for lower VRAM.

workflows.title: FLUX.1 Krea [dev] Text to Image
workflows.source: official template flux1_krea_dev from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Photorealistic "opinionated" FLUX.1 dev fine-tune by Krea (fp8 scaled weights). Shares text encoders + ae.safetensors with flux1-dev-t2i.

workflows.title: FLUX.1 [schnell] Text to Image
workflows.notes: 4-step distilled, Apache-2.0 licence (commercial OK). Prompt goes to both CLIP-L and T5 fields of CLIPTextEncodeFlux. Guidance is ignored by schnell.

workflows.title: FLUX.2 [dev] Text to Image
workflows.notes: Mistral-Small text encoder (18 GB bf16) + 32B fp8mixed transformer; needs ~64 GB system RAM for offloading on 24 GB cards. Width/height must be set on BOTH the latent and the Flux2Scheduler (both listed).

workflows.title: FLUX.2 [dev] Text to Image (Turbo LoRA, 8-step)
workflows.notes: Same as flux2-dev-t2i with the official template's "Enable Turbo LoRA" path (Flux_2-Turbo-LoRA, 8 steps).

workflows.title: FLUX.2 [dev] Image Edit (1 reference)
workflows.notes: Output size follows the input image rescaled to ~1 megapixel (ImageScaleToTotalPixels node 45, megapixels=1).

workflows.title: FLUX.2 [dev] Multi-Reference Edit (3 images)
workflows.source: official template image_flux2 from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Official FLUX.2 edit template extended with two more chained ReferenceLatent inputs (FLUX.2 supports up to ~10). All three images are required; refer to them in the prompt as "image 1/2/3". Output size follows image 1 (~1 MP).

workflows.title: Qwen-Image 2512 Text to Image
workflows.notes: Best open model for in-image text rendering (EN/ZH). Native 1328x1328; recommended sizes 1664x928 (16:9), 928x1664 (9:16), 1472x1104 (4:3). 50 steps cfg 4 by default.

workflows.title: Qwen-Image 2512 Text to Image (Lightning 4-step)
workflows.notes: Official template with "Enable 4 Steps LoRA" on (Qwen-Image-2512-Lightning-4steps, cfg 1). ~10x faster than qwen-image-2512-t2i.

workflows.title: Z-Image Turbo Text to Image
workflows.notes: 6B distilled model, 8 steps, cfg 1 (no negative prompt). Fastest high-quality option; fits 12-16 GB GPUs.

workflows.title: HiDream-I1 Dev Text to Image
workflows.notes: 17B MoE (fp8). Four text encoders incl. Llama-3.1-8B (fp8). Dev variant: 28 steps, cfg 1, lcm sampler; negative prompt has little effect at cfg 1.

workflows.title: SDXL 1.0 Text to Image
workflows.source: official template image_sdxl_simple from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Lightweight baseline (single 6.9 GB checkpoint). Native 1024x1024 class resolutions. Default negative prompt replaced with a generic one.

workflows.title: Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 (Lightning 4-step)
workflows.notes: Official template default keeps "Enable Lightning LoRA" ON (4 steps, cfg 1). Input is rescaled to ~1 MP (FluxKontextImageScale); output size follows the input.

workflows.title: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511
workflows.source: official template image_qwen_image_edit_2511 from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Derived from the official 2511 "material replacement" template with the 2nd reference removed. 40 steps, cfg 4 (Lightning LoRA path disabled). Better identity/consistency than 2509.

workflows.title: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 Multi-Image (3 images)
workflows.source: official template image_qwen_image_edit_2511 from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus takes up to 3 images; refer to them as "image 1/2/3" in the prompt. All three are required. Output size follows image 1.

workflows.title: FLUX.1 Kontext [dev] Image Edit
workflows.notes: Instruction edit ("change the background to ..."). Output follows the input aspect at ~1 MP (FluxKontextImageScale).

workflows.title: FLUX.1 Fill [dev] Inpaint
workflows.source: official template flux_fill_inpaint_example from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: mask = separate uploaded PNG, same size as image, read from the RED channel: white (255) = area to regenerate, black = keep. Guidance 30 is correct for Fill.

workflows.title: FLUX.1 Fill [dev] Outpaint
workflows.notes: Extends the canvas by padLeft/padTop/padRight/padBottom pixels (multiples of 8) and fills it. Keep final size <= ~2 MP.

workflows.title: Image Upscale (Real-ESRGAN 4x)
workflows.notes: Hand-built: UpscaleModelLoader -> ImageUpscaleWithModel -> ImageScaleBy. The model fixes the factor (x4 for RealESRGAN_x4plus); `scale` resizes AFTER the model (0.5 => net 2x). Any spandrel-supported model in models/upscale_models works as upscaleModel.

workflows.title: Image Upscale / Restore (SeedVR2 7B int8)
workflows.notes: Native SeedVR2 nodes (core ComfyUI >= 0.28), one-step diffusion restoration. scale = output multiplier (template 4). The numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler pack is NOT used (it cannot register on CPU-only hosts and is superseded by core nodes).

workflows.title: Remove Background (BiRefNet, native)
workflows.source: official template utility_birefnet_remove_background from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Native core nodes (LoadBackgroundRemovalModel/RemoveBackground). Output is an RGBA PNG (transparent background). Template preview nodes replaced with SaveImage. MIT-licensed model.

workflows.title: Remove Background (ComfyUI-RMBG, BEN2)
workflows.notes: Custom pack alternative to bg-remove-birefnet. Model choices on node 2: RMBG-2.0 (best, but CC BY-NC 4.0 non-commercial), INSPYRENET, BEN, BEN2 (default). Output RGBA PNG.
autoDownloads: ComfyUI-RMBG downloads the selected model (BEN2 -> models/RMBG/BEN2) from Hugging Face on first run

workflows.title: Face Swap (ReActor)
workflows.notes: image = target photo (faces get replaced), image2 = source face. inswapper_128 is research/non-commercial licensed; ReActor applies an NSFW detector by default. Requires the insightface Python package (pip wheel insightface 2.1 installs fine on Python 3.13).
autoDownloads: insightface buffalo_l face analysis models -> models/insightface/models/buffalo_l (downloaded by ReActor on first run)
retinaface_resnet50 detector -> models/facedetection (downloaded on first run)

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B Text to Video
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_14B_t2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Two-expert MoE: high-noise model runs the first half of the steps, low-noise model the rest. The high/low split step is a separate primitive (10 of 20); if you change steps, keep it roughly at steps/2 (not exposed as a binding). Default 640x640, 81 frames @16 fps (5 s); 1280x720 works on 24 GB+ with offloading. Template default 20 steps, cfg 3.5.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B Text to Video (lightx2v 4-step)
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_14B_t2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Two-expert MoE: high-noise model runs the first half of the steps, low-noise model the rest. The high/low split step is a separate primitive (2 of 4); if you change steps, keep it roughly at steps/2 (not exposed as a binding). Default 640x640, 81 frames @16 fps (5 s); 1280x720 works on 24 GB+ with offloading. Uses the official Wan2.2 lightx2v 4-step LoRAs (cfg 1): ~5x faster, less motion.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B Image to Video
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_14B_i2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: High/low split step fixed at 10 of 20 (not a binding). Default 640x640, 81 frames @16 fps. Template default 20 steps, cfg 3.5.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B Image to Video (lightx2v 4-step)
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_14B_i2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: High/low split step fixed at 2 of 4 (not a binding). Default 640x640, 81 frames @16 fps. Official lightx2v 4-step LoRAs, cfg 1.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B Image to Video + LoRA (camera/VFX)
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_14B_i2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Derived from the official template: LoraLoaderModelOnly inserted after BOTH the high-noise (node 1001) and low-noise (node 1002) UNETLoader. Wan 2.2 effect/camera LoRAs ship as high/low pairs; loraHigh and loraLow must both name files present in models/loras (the default names are placeholders, not downloadable). For a LoRA that only has one file, pass the same file for both (or use wan22-i2v-14b if no LoRA is wanted); loraStrength applies to both. High/low split step fixed at 10 of 20 (not a binding). Default 640x640, 81 frames @16 fps. Template default 20 steps, cfg 3.5.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 5B Text to Video (720p)
workflows.notes: Dense 5B model with the high-compression Wan2.2 VAE: 1280x704 @24 fps, 121 frames (5 s). Fits 12 GB with offloading. Best consumer-GPU video option.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 5B Image to Video (720p)
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_5B_ti2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Same as wan22-ti2v-5b with the optional start_image input of Wan22ImageToVideoLatent wired to a LoadImage (the official template documents this as the I2V mode). Image is used at the given width/height; pre-crop to the target aspect.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B First-Last Frame to Video
workflows.notes: Uses the Wan 2.2 I2V high/low experts. High->low switch at step 10 (end_at_step of node 84 / start_at_step of node 87, not a binding). Start and end images should share the output aspect ratio.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B Fun Camera Control (image to video)
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_14B_fun_camera from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: cameraMotion is one of: Static, Pan Up, Pan Down, Pan Left, Pan Right, Zoom In, Zoom Out, Anti Clockwise (ACW), ClockWise (CW). width/height/frames live on WanCameraEmbedding (node 108) which feeds WanCameraImageToVideo. Default changed from "Static" to "Zoom In".

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 14B Fun Control (reference image + control video)
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_2_14B_fun_control from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: image = reference/first frame (style + identity), video = driving clip; structure/motion is transferred via Canny edges computed in-graph (node 1601). Only the first `frames` frames of the video are used; feed a ~16 fps clip so motion speed is preserved. Swap node 1601 for depth/pose preprocessors if you install comfyui_controlnet_aux.

workflows.title: Wan 2.1 VACE 14B Reference to Video
workflows.notes: Subject/character reference (not a first frame): the reference appears in a newly composed scene. fp16 14B weights (34.7 GB) + CausVid LoRA at 0.3 for 4-step sampling. 24 GB cards need weight_dtype fp8_e4m3fn on node 113.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B Talking Video (image + audio)
workflows.notes: Audio-driven speaking/singing video with body motion. Fixed length: 1 base chunk + 2 extend subgraphs of 77 frames @16 fps (~14 s); shorter audio is padded, longer audio is cut. Output muxes the input audio. Uses the lightx2v 4-step LoRA by default (steps 4, cfg 1; without it use 20 / 6.0).

workflows.title: Wan Animate 2 Motion Transfer (character + driving video)
workflows.source: official template video_wan_animate2 from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: image = character reference, video = driving video (raw frames; no pose extraction needed). Processes the whole driving video in 81-frame fragments via native loop nodes; output keeps the driving video fps + audio. prompt = character/background description (node 672:582); the separate pose prompt (672:585) is set to a generic motion description. The side-by-side comparison output of the template was removed.

workflows.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5 Text to Video (720p)
workflows.notes: 8.3B model, 1280x720, 121 frames @24 fps (5 s), 20 steps cfg 6. The template's optional 1080p super-resolution stage is bypassed (not exported).

workflows.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5 Image to Video (720p)
workflows.notes: Uses SigCLIP vision conditioning + first frame. 1280x720, 121 frames @24 fps.

workflows.title: LTX-2 Text to Video + Audio
workflows.notes: Generates synchronized audio (speech/SFX/music) together with video. Two-stage: base pass at width/2 x height/2, then 2x latent upscale + 3-step distilled refine, so width/height are the FINAL size (multiples of 64). frames must be 8n+1 (121 = 5 s @24 fps). fps is set on both the float and int primitives.

workflows.title: LTX-2 Image to Video + Audio
workflows.notes: Input image is center-cropped/resized to width x height (node 102). Same two-stage pipeline as ltx2-t2v; produces audio. fps (25 by default) must be set in three places (all listed).

workflows.title: LTX-2.5 Text to Video + Audio (distilled)
workflows.source: official template video_ltx2_5_t2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Newest LTX (22B distilled, int8). Fixed manual sigma schedules (no steps/cfg). width/height are FINAL size (base pass at half size, then 2x latent upscale) -> multiples of 64. frames = seconds*fps+1 (template default 5 s @24 fps = 121). The template's optional Gemma prompt-enhancer branch is disabled.

workflows.title: LTX-2.5 Image to Video + Audio (distilled)
workflows.source: official template video_ltx2_5_i2v from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: First-frame conditioning (strength 0.7 base pass, 1.0 refine). Same size/frames rules as ltx25-t2v. Image is resized to longer side 1536 before conditioning; give it the output aspect ratio.

workflows.title: InfiniteTalk Lip-sync (native, single speaker, ~6 s)
workflows.source: official template video_wan2_1_infinitetalk from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Official native InfiniteTalk template converted from two-speaker to single-speaker (single-speaker InfiniteTalk patch, masks/2nd audio/first-pass preview output removed). Two 81-frame windows @25 fps => ~6 s; audio beyond that is not animated (trim audio to <= 6 s). For long clips use infinitetalk-wanwrapper.

workflows.title: InfiniteTalk Lip-sync (WanVideoWrapper, long audio)
workflows.notes: kijai WanVideoWrapper example 03 (GGUF Q8 Wan2.1-I2V-480p + InfiniteTalk single, lightx2v LoRA, 6 steps). Generates in 81-frame windows until the audio ends; `frames` is a MAX frame cap @25 fps (default 500 = 20 s). Changes vs example: MelBandRoFormer vocal separation removed (use clean speech audio), attention sdpa instead of sageattn, save_output=true, Windows sub-paths flattened. Output is a VHS_VideoCombine node: look in history outputs[node].gifs[], not .images[].
autoDownloads: DownloadAndLoadWav2VecModel downloads TencentGameMate/chinese-wav2vec2-base into models/transformers on first run

workflows.title: Video Upscale / Restore (SeedVR2 3B int8)
workflows.notes: Native SeedVR2 (one-step diffusion restoration, temporally consistent). scale = output multiplier (template 2). Keeps source fps + audio. Temporal latent chunking is off (template default); long or 1080p+ clips need more VRAM.

workflows.title: Video Upscale (Real-ESRGAN 4x)
workflows.notes: Fast GAN upscale frame by frame (no new detail). Output factor = model factor (x4). Keeps fps + audio.

workflows.title: Frame Interpolation (FILM, native)
workflows.notes: Native FrameInterpolate node. Output fps = source fps x multiplier (same duration, smoother motion). Audio passthrough.

workflows.title: Frame Interpolation (RIFE 4.26, native)
workflows.source: official template utility_video_frame_interpolation from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Same official template with the RIFE v4.26 checkpoint (template lists rife_v4.25/4.26 variants in Comfy-Org/frame_interpolation). Faster than FILM.

workflows.title: Frame Interpolation (RIFE VFI custom pack)
workflows.notes: Fannovel16/ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation + VideoHelperSuite alternative to interpolate-rife. Output fps = source fps x multiplier (VHS_VideoInfo + ComfyMathExpression). Output is VHS_VideoCombine (history .gifs[]).
autoDownloads: RIFE VFI downloads rife49.pth into custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation/ckpts/rife on first run

workflows.title: ACE-Step 1.5 Music (tags + lyrics)
workflows.source: official template audio_ace_step_1_5_checkpoint from comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.86 (modified, see notes)
workflows.notes: Turbo AIO checkpoint (8 steps). tags = style description, lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus] markers ("[Instrumental]" or empty for instrumental). Output MP3 V0 (changed from FLAC). Defaults changed to 60 s / 120 bpm. Language/keyscale/timesignature stay at template values (en, E minor, 4).

workflows.title: Video to Audio / Foley (MMAudio)
workflows.notes: kijai ComfyUI-MMAudio example. Audio duration = loaded video duration (VHS_VideoInfo). Two outputs: the input video muxed with generated audio (VHS_VideoCombine -> history .gifs[]) and the FLAC track (SaveAudio -> history .audio[]). MMAudio is trained on 8 s clips; quality drops on long inputs.

workflows.title: Chatterbox Multilingual TTS (voice clone, 23 languages)
workflows.license: Chatterbox weights MIT (ResembleAI); pack repo has no LICENSE file
workflows.notes: Template audio-chatterbox_tts_multilingual. prompt = text to speak; audio = 5-15 s clean reference of the voice to clone (required in this graph). language is a combo of "Name (code)" strings: Arabic (ar), Danish (da), German (de), Greek (el), English (en), Spanish (es), Finnish (fi), French (fr), Hebrew (he), Hindi (hi), Italian (it), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Malay (ms), Dutch (nl), Norwegian (no), Polish (pl), Portuguese (pt), Russian (ru), Swedish (sv), Swahili (sw), Turkish (tr), Chinese (zh). cfg = cfg_weight (0-1, default 0.5; lower = slower, more deliberate pacing), exaggeration 0-2 (0.5 neutral), temperature 0.05-2 (0.8). Long text is chunked by the node. seed is folded to 32 bits in the graph (node 11, the FL nodes cap seed at 2^32-1). Output MP3 V0. Install resemble-perth so outputs carry the Perth watermark (the pack treats it as optional). Get consent for cloned voices.
autoDownloads: FL_ChatterboxMultilingualTTS downloads ResembleAI/chatterbox (t3_mtl23ls_v2.safetensors 2.14 GB, s3gen.pt 1.06 GB, ve.pt, conds.pt, grapheme_mtl_merged_expanded_v1.json, Cangjie5_TC.json) into models/chatterbox/chatterbox_multilingual on first run

workflows.title: IndexTTS-2 TTS (voice clone, expressive)
workflows.license: bilibili IndexTTS-2 Model Use License: commercial use allowed below 100M MAU / RMB 1B annual revenue; may not be used to improve other AI models. Pack code: no LICENSE file
workflows.notes: IndexTTS2Simple(audio = speaker reference, text, emotion_control_weight 1.0, use_fp16 true). No seed input. Best for emotion/timing control (dubbing). Validated with the pack registered (it imports only numpy at load time); its runtime stack (pynini, WeTextProcessing, modelscope, descript-audiotools, ...) is NOT installed by default - run install-comfyui.sh with INDEXTTS_RUNTIME=1, ideally in a separate worker. Emotion from a second clip or a vector (IndexTTS2EmotionVector / IndexTTS2EmotionFromText) is not wired.
autoDownloads: IndexTeam/IndexTTS-2 must be in custom_nodes/ComfyUI-IndexTTS2/checkpoints (gpt.pth 3.48 GB, s2mel.pth 1.2 GB, qwen0.6bemo4-merge 1.19 GB, config.yaml, bpe.model, ...); w2v-bert-2.0, MaskGCT semantic codec, CAMPPlus and BigVGAN are fetched from Hugging Face on first run

workflows.title: Chatterbox Dialogue (2 speakers, voice clone)
workflows.license: Chatterbox weights MIT (ResembleAI); pack repo has no LICENSE file
workflows.notes: Template audio-chatterbox_tts_dialog. prompt = script, one line per turn starting with "SPEAKER A:" or "SPEAKER B:" (parsed with startswith). audio = speaker A reference, audio2 = speaker B reference. English model only. The node also outputs per-speaker stems (outputs 1-4, not saved here) that suit multi-person lipsync; speakers C/D need optional inputs speaker_C_Audio/speaker_D_Audio (not wired). cfg = cfg_weight (0.2-1), exaggeration 0.25-2, temperature 0.05-5. seed is folded to 32 bits in the graph (node 11). Output MP3 V0 of the mixed dialogue.
autoDownloads: FL_ChatterboxDialogTTS downloads ResembleAI/chatterbox English model (t3_cfg.safetensors 2.13 GB, s3gen.safetensors 1.06 GB, ve.safetensors, tokenizer.json, conds.pt) into models/chatterbox/chatterbox on first run

workflows.title: Chatterbox Voice Changer (speech to speech)
workflows.license: Chatterbox weights MIT (ResembleAI); pack repo has no LICENSE file
workflows.notes: Template audio-chatterbox_vc. audio = performance to convert (timing and prosody are kept), audio2 = 5-15 s of the target voice. Zero-shot, no training. seed is folded to 32 bits in the graph (node 11). To re-voice a video: extract its audio client-side (or GetVideoComponents.audio -> FL_ChatterboxVC -> CreateVideo(audio=...)) and remux.
autoDownloads: FL_ChatterboxVC downloads ResembleAI/chatterbox s3gen.pt (1.06 GB) + conds.pt into models/chatterbox/chatterbox_vc on first run

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE Video Extend (lightx2v 4-step)
workflows.license: Apache-2.0 (Wan 2.2 Fun VACE, Wan 2.2 lightx2v LoRAs)
workflows.notes: Continues a clip. frames = NEW frames to generate (4n+1, from duration*fps); contextFrames = how many of the source's last frames are fed back as known context (multiple of 4, default 16). The graph computes window = frames + contextFrames (ComfyMathExpression, must stay <= 121) and the negative tail index itself. WanVaceToVideo control: last contextFrames frames (mask 0 = keep) + gray frames (mask 1 = generate). Output = whole source clip resized/center-cropped to width x height + the new frames, overlap linear-blended (KJNodes ImageBatchExtendWithOverlap), at fps (16 = Wan native; resample the source to 16 fps first). Run repeatedly on the result to extend further. Source audio is dropped. 4 steps split 2/2 high/low (split not bound), cfg 1, shift 5. Fun VACE + T2V lightx2v LoRA pairing is inferred from the shared A14B T2V base (not GPU-tested).

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE Video Reframe / Outpaint
workflows.license: Apache-2.0 (Wan 2.2 Fun VACE, Wan 2.2 lightx2v LoRAs)
workflows.notes: Changes the aspect ratio of a clip and fills the new area. width/height = TARGET size (from aspectRatio); KJNodes ImageResizeKJv2 (keep_proportion=pad, center, divisible_by 16) fits the source inside it, pads with 0.5 gray and outputs mask 1 on the padding, 0 on the source (per frame) -> WanVaceToVideo control_video/control_masks (pattern of template video_wan_vace_outpainting, re-targeted to Wan 2.2 Fun VACE). frames must be <= the source frame count (4n+1): WanVaceToVideo trims the control video to frames, and pads a shorter one with gray + mask 1 (= invents frames). Only call it when the aspect ratio actually changes (no padding -> ImageResizeKJv2 returns a 64x64 placeholder mask and the whole clip would be regenerated). Clips longer than ~5-7 s: run windows and reuse the previous window's last frames (see video-extend). Source audio is dropped. 4 steps split 2/2, cfg 1, shift 5.

workflows.title: Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 Relight (prompted lighting)
workflows.license: Apache-2.0 (Qwen-Image-Edit-2509, Relight LoRA, Lightning LoRA)
workflows.notes: Official template image_qwen_image_edit_2509_relight = library qwen-image-edit-2509 + node 1001 (Relight LoRA after the Lightning LoRA) + node 1002 (StringConcatenate prefixing the LoRA trigger "重新照明," = "relight,"). prompt = the light to apply, e.g. "relight with neon magenta and cyan rim lights" (Chinese prompts follow the LoRA captions best). Output size follows the input (~1 MP). 4 steps, cfg 1.

workflows.title: Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 Relight from Reference (light migration)
workflows.license: Apache-2.0 (Qwen-Image-Edit-2509, Light-Migration LoRA, Lightning LoRA)
workflows.notes: Template templates-portrait_light_migration: image = subject, image2 = lighting reference (wired as image2 of both TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus). Node 1002 prefixes the template instruction ("参考色调，移除图1原有的光照并参考图2的光照和色调对图1重新照明" = remove image 1's lighting and relight it with image 2's light and tone); prompt may stay empty or add constraints. 4 steps, cfg 1.

workflows.title: Bernini-R Video Relight / Restyle (lightx2v 6-step)
workflows.license: Apache-2.0 (ByteDance Bernini-R, lightx2v)
workflows.notes: Official template video_bernini_r_video_editing, subgraph flattened with its turbo switch ON: lightx2v T2V v2 rank64 LoRA at 3.0 (high) / 1.5 (low), 6 steps split at 3 (SplitSigmas, not bound), cfg 1, res_multistep. Node 5 prepends the template system prompt for style/lighting/colour edits; prompt = the edit, e.g. "Relight the scene as golden hour, warm low sun from the left; keep subject, motion and framing unchanged". BerniniConditioning resizes/center-crops the source to width x height and trims it to frames (use the source aspect ratio and frame count, 4n+1). Output fps = source fps (linked), no audio. Also works as general prompt-driven video restyle. Turbo off (template): 40 steps split 20, cfg 5, no LoRA. Very new weights (2026-06): GPU smoke-test before exposing.

workflows.title: Burn captions into a video (core Draw Text Overlay, chunk by chunk)
workflows.license: no model (ComfyUI core TextOverlay, GPL-3.0 like ComfyUI; Pillow's bundled Aileron font, OFL)
workflows.notes: Fuobe's open caption burn-in, all inside ComfyUI with core nodes. The provider rewrites the graph per request (expandCaptionWorkflow): the cues (prompt lines "start-end: text" or SRT, e.g. from captions-qwen3-asr) cut the clip into Trim Video windows. Gaps go straight to Concatenate Video (never decoded). A cue window is cut into chunks of at most ~384 MB of frames (about 0.5 s of 1080x1920 at 30 fps, 5 s at 360p); each chunk is decoded (GetVideoComponents), gets a TextOverlay in the style of node 12 (fontSize = % of the frame height, fontColor, captionPosition top | bottom, outlined) and is encoded at once (CreateVideo codec h264), so ComfyUI only needs one chunk of raw frames at a time and can evict finished chunks under memory pressure. Concatenate Video joins chunks and gaps in order and lays the clip's own soundtrack (LoadAudio, node 3) under the result; for a silent clip node 3 is dropped. The provider reads the upload's MP4 header for duration, fps, size and audio: window edges sit between frames, cues past the end are dropped and the rest of the clip after the last cue stays uncaptioned. Windows hold at least 3 frames (Concatenate Video rejects a 2-frame clip followed by another): a shorter pause between cues gets no gap, a shorter caption is held for 3 frames. Measured on the CPU server under RAM pressure (--cache-ram 11): a 20 s 640x360 30 fps clip with 18 s of captions peaks at +0.50 GB RSS and a 40 s one at +0.45 GB (the old one-batch graph: +5.16 GB for the 20 s clip); without pressure ComfyUI's RAM cache keeps finished chunks (+2.64 GB for 20 s) until memory runs low. Runs on CPU (verified end to end through Fuobe).

workflows.title: Voice track on the video's timeline: spoken lines placed at their start times over silence (core audio nodes)
workflows.license: n/a (no model; ComfyUI core audio nodes)
workflows.notes: The dub voice track, all core nodes. The template places one line: EmptyAudio of the video's length (duration) is the track, the line (audio) is cut where the next line starts (TrimAudioDuration), put after startTime seconds of silence (AudioConcat after EmptyAudio) and added onto the track (AudioMerge add: pads or cuts the line to the track). The provider rewrites the graph per request (expandTimelineWorkflow, src/lib/av/timeline.ts): params.extra.timeline = {length, clips:[{start, duration}]} with one inputs.audios clip per entry, each loaded, cut, led in and added in turn, so the saved track is exactly as long as the video with every line at its cue time (pauses kept). SaveAudio writes FLAC (lossless, no MP3 priming delay). Feeds lip re-sync (InfiniteTalk frames = the track's length = the video's) and video-mux-audio. Runs on CPU.
